The structure of composition H2N2O4 (reduced formula HNO2) crystallizes in the triclinic space group P1, with a unit cell containing 8 atoms distributed over 8 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows two N-centered tetrahedral environments: one with four O neighbors and another with three O and one N neighbor, while H centers are coordinated by a single N atom. O centers display 3- or 4-coordinate geometric environments, including one octahedral motif. The neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 8 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts show corner- and edge-sharing between N tetrahedra and O octahedra, as well as corner-sharing between O octahedra.
